content: iOS Safari PWA file handling: (1) input type=file WORKS for import in standalone PWA mode. (2) Anchor download attribute DOES NOT reliably work in iOS PWA standalone mode (WebKit bug #275288, unresolved as of 2024). (3) Workaround for export: Web Share API (navigator.share({files:[blob]})) IS supported on iOS Safari. Pattern: check navigator.canShare({files:[blob]}) first; if supported, call navigator.share(); else fallback to window.open(objectURL). File selection dialog issue: if user closes PWA while dialog open, dialog won't reappear on reopen.
